context:
North Star: identify stable, learnable observables produced by norm-preserving recurrent dynamics and transport-stable symmetry/commutant structure, with preregistered discriminating experiments and no post-result tuning.

Sealed public result: UP-238B-extreme-far-centered-parity qualified as EXTREME_TRANSFER_PERFECT. A frozen family-centered near_zero_margin_count parity observable trained only on phases 58..72 achieved 1.0 accuracy on the parent far window 185..216 and again 1.0 accuracy on the disjoint extreme-far window 249..280. Each of four frozen families had 32/32 correct states. No evaluation fitting, recentering, phase input, adaptive feature selection, or nonlinear classifier was used.

Interpretation boundary: this establishes very long-range phase transfer for the frozen parity observable; it does not yet establish that the observable is invariant to a changed family composition, changed training-family support, or a deliberately adversarial phase/family regime.

Select one next experiment with maximal information value. Preserve the frozen observable wherever possible and change one mechanistic factor. Prefer a test that can distinguish genuine transport-stable invariance from accidental persistence on the same family construction. Do not retune thresholds or use evaluation labels. Provide: question, hypothesis, exact intervention/ablation, controls, frozen variables, primary metric, preregistered classifications, and why this is more discriminating than simply extending the phase window again.
